VERDICT done_when: the plan's §7 done_when names the new remote test plus "importer arms add no failure"; logs/after_suite.log records 18 passed EXIT=0 at 75884c8bbf over the two files and logs/baseline_suite.log records 4 failed 14 passed EXIT=1 at 1219837c0f, so the repaired importer file is measured, while the three other importer files (green at the base in logs/importer_arm.log) are inferred rather than re-measured at the head.
